views.label: Engagement
views.alt: Input diagram highlighting how the user's head pose feeds the engagement score.

views.label: Cognitive load
views.alt: Input diagram highlighting a task-level estimate of the user's cognitive load.
views.caption: In the study, cognitive load was predefined for the task. In the demo, a vision-language model estimated it from video.

views.label: Relevance
views.alt: Input diagram comparing the delivered object with the task the user is doing.
views.caption: In the study, relevance was predefined for each delivery. In the demo, a language model estimated it from the delivery and task context.

views.label: Urgency
views.alt: Input diagram highlighting urgency alongside the relevance of a delivery.
views.caption: In the study, urgency was predefined for each delivery. In the demo, a language model estimated it from the delivery and task context.

views.label: Distance
views.alt: Input diagram highlighting the robot's distance from the user.

views.label: Clarity
views.alt: Slide highlighting the clarity term for approach speed and speech detail.

views.label: Disturbance
views.alt: Slide highlighting movement and speech penalties for disturbing a busy user.

views.label: Delay
views.alt: Slide highlighting how delay favors progress and shorter explanations for urgent deliveries.

views.label: Speech LOD
views.alt: Three levels of speech detail add information in sequence: the delivered item, advice on how to use it, and the benefit of that action.

views.label: Speech timing
views.alt: The robot can speak at different points along its approach path.

views.label: Approach speed
views.alt: The robot initially hesitates, then approaches the user more directly.
